podcast.body: This song was featured on the "Factory Sampler" compilation album, released in January 1979, marking one of Joy Division's early contributions to Tony Wilson's newly formed Factory Records. "And here's one of their songs from that factory sampler album. This is called Digital."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What's the Big Deal About Joy Division?

podcast.body: This song was one of two tracks by Joy Division featured on the first ever release by Factory Records, issued on December 24, 1978. It was part of a bundled set of two 7-inch singles showcasing samples from four bands on the label's roster. "Side A was taken up with two songs by a band called Joy Division. One of them was called Digital."
